questions.stem: What is the main use case addressed by Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)?
options: Automating the exchange of business documents such as purchase orders and invoices between trading partners
Backing up databases to the cloud
questions.explanation: EDI automates data exchange between trading partners for business documents such as purchase orders, invoices, payments and shipment information.

questions.stem: Since which decade has EDI been in use?
questions.explanation: EDI has been introduced since the seventies.

questions.stem: Which are the two main EDI message standards?
questions.explanation: EDIFACT and X12 are the main EDI message standards; ODETTE, HL7, IATA PATIS and SWIFT serve specific industries.

questions.stem: Which EDI standard is used for healthcare data?
questions.explanation: HL7 is the EDI standard used for healthcare data; ODETTE is automotive, IATA PATIS is passenger and airport data, SWIFT is finance and banking.

questions.stem: In which region is EDI X12 widely used, with UN/EDIFACT being the standard elsewhere?
questions.explanation: EDI X12 is widely used in North America; UN/EDIFACT is used in many other countries, particularly in Europe.

questions.stem: Which X12 transaction number represents a Purchase Order?
questions.explanation: X12 transaction 850 is the Purchase Order; 810 is Invoice, 820 is Payment Order, 856 is Ship Notice/Manifest and 945 is Warehouse Shipping Advice.

questions.stem: Which UN/EDIFACT document type represents an Invoice?
questions.explanation: INVOIC is the UN/EDIFACT document type for an Invoice; ORDERS is Order, DELFOR is Delivery Schedule, DISADV is Dispatch Advice and RECADV is Receiving Advice.

questions.stem: Which communication protocols are named as typical for transmitting EDI transactions?
options: AS2, FTP or VANs (Value Added Networks)
questions.explanation: EDI transactions are typically transmitted over secure, standardised protocols such as AS2 (Applicability Statement 2), FTP or VANs.

questions.stem: Why is the question of whether suppliers use EDI considered not a major criterion when assessing EDI adoption?
options: Because suppliers always pay for the integration
Because EDI cannot be used with suppliers
Because supplier data is exchanged only by email
Because as their customer, suppliers will have to conform to your requirement
questions.explanation: Since you are the supplier's customer, they will have to conform to your requirement; it only becomes an opportunity to streamline if many suppliers already use EDI.

questions.stem: What advantage does EDI retain over web services and API-based integrations?
options: Reliability and deliverability, since it is persistent by design
It is more modern and secure
It is free of communication protocols
questions.explanation: Web services and APIs are more modern and secure, but EDI still has advantages in reliability and deliverability because it is persistent by design.
